title: Finite-shock asymmetry identifies symmetrized curvature, including reserve kinks
checked_scope: Convex financing-response functions on a fixed same-state shock interval, allowing nondifferentiable hinges. Radial curvature is identified only on [0,A); the converse assumes a finite convex nondecreasing extension beyond A.
significance: Extends the smooth curvature identity to a curvature measure and characterizes exactly what a whole asymmetry profile identifies and which left–right threshold ambiguity remains.
